_comment: Per-motor tuning for the NXT xylophone. Edit a value, SAVE, and the bridge hot-reloads it live (no restart) — then press a key in the Web UI to test. Each motor inherits everything from `defaults`; under `motors` add ONLY the keys you want to override for that one note. See docs/motor-tuning.md. These same settings govern BOTH manual key presses and full songs played from note-reader/main.py. pressDegrees = max PRESS rotation, returnDegrees = max RETURN rotation (defaults to pressDegrees), pressSettleMs = the press is locked in for this long so a slow press still reaches its rotation before it can roll back.
